name: Osei Datathread Collar Necklace
description:
A flat woven collar-necklace in black and deep indigo, constructed from conductive thread in a kente-derived interlocking geometry. Embedded along the inner weave are three micro data-chip nodes disguised as decorative brass-toned beads — indistinguishable from ornament unless you know the activation press sequence.

The textile sits flat against the collarbone, roughly 2cm wide. The weave pattern shifts subtly under UV — a street authentication mark used by Circuit information brokers. Looks like jewelry. Functions like a dead-drop.
functionality: Three embedded data-chip nodes store up to 8TB encrypted each; activation via sequential bead-press; UV-reactive weave pattern functions as street-level authentication marker; passive NFC read-block when nodes are inactive.
what_it_says: Information is currency, and you carry yours close to the throat.
story_hooks: One bead node in a circulating batch contains a partial AI personality fragment — whoever loaded it didn't finish the wipe.
The UV authentication pattern has been counterfeited by a rival broker network, causing violent misidentification on neutral ground.
A Tier-5 compliance officer is collecting these off bodies — the data they contain may connect to a corponation merger that was never made public.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sophisticated flat collar-necklace that drapes snugly against the collarbone, appearing as traditional textile jewelry. The interlocking geometric weave creates a visual rhythm that reads as haute-cultural, drawing on Akan kente aesthetics. Sits close to the skin, emphasizing the neckline without bulk.
physical_description.fit: Slim, form-fitting collar lying flat against the collarbone; approximately 2cm wide band that follows the curve of the neck without constriction. Adjustable closure allows wear over augmented necks and natural ones alike.
physical_description.primary_material: Conductive thread woven into a dense textile base; micro data-chip nodes embedded throughout. Appears entirely organic from distance.
physical_description.texture: Smooth weave surface with subtle ribbing from the interlocking pattern. The three embedded nodes register as small raised points under the fingertip, easily mistaken for decorative beads. Inner surface has a slight grip quality to prevent slipping.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant black base with deep indigo interlocking geometric bands in traditional kente-derived patterns. Three brass-toned micro bead nodes distributed along the weave. Shifts to faint ultraviolet luminescence under UV light—barely visible unless you're looking.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit magnetic closure at the nape, disguised as a traditional clasp ornament. Seamless when fastened.
distinctive_features: Kente-derived interlocking geometry creates visual authentication signature
Three embedded micro data-chip nodes disguised as brass-toned decorative beads
UV-reactive authentication pattern woven into the textile structure
Conductive thread allows data transfer when activated via precise pressure sequence
Osei & Park maker's mark subtly woven into one corner of the weave
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional luxury; appears high-end artisanal to Tier 1 observers, but street-knowledgeable users recognize it as professional-grade information infrastructure.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by Circuit information brokers, street data couriers, and underground network operatives who need secure, deniable data transfer. The kente aesthetic signals diaspora heritage and community-rooted resistance tech. Not corpo, not military—distinctly street intelligence.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops a subtle patina from skin oils and repeated pressure-activation over months. Remains functionally perfect; may show minor color deepening at wear points.
